newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia says successfully tests SS-19 missile.
newsitem.headline: Russia says successfully tests SS-19 missile.

text.p: Russia's Strategic Missile Forces carried out a successful test firing of an SS-19 intercontinental ballistic missile on Tuesday, a spokesman for the strategic command told Interfax news agency.

All the dummy warheads hit their targets on the Pacific peninsula of Kamchatka following the launch from the Baikonur launch site in Kazakhstan, it quoted the acting head of the missile forces, General Vladimir Yakovlev, as saying.
The test was to check the possibilities of extending the useful life of this class of missile and the result demonstrated its reliability after many years of service, Interfax said.

"Our strategic missiles have again proved in practice the great reliability and effectiveness of the Strategic Missile Forces' weaponry and the solidity of Russia's nuclear shield as a whole," Yakovlev said. Russia tests its missiles regularly.

Some officials have voiced concerns about the effectiveness and safety of Russia's nuclear arsenal in the midst of a severe funding crisis. The former head of the strategic command, General Igor Sergeyev, was named defence minister last month with a brief to start far-reaching army reforms to save money.
